Asparagus is field crops unlocked at experience level 49. It was added in Summer 2023 Update.

It's used to make asparagus quiche, asparagus soup, grilled asparagus, spring omelet and breakfast waffles. 

Like all crops, it is stored in the silo.

If you have none in your silo, you can buy 10 for 650 coin.

Growing asparagus

Asparagus is grown in fields by planting another asparagus (either previously harvested or purchased). Each plot yields 2 plants (net gain of 1 plant) and 8 experience points, and takes 6 hours to mature.

Asparagus Stage 1.png

Asparagus Stage 4.png
Asparagus Stage 5.png

Selling asparagus

  • Asparagus can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 432 coin for 10 units.

Using asparagus

Asparagus is used to make the following products:


Asparagus Quiche Asparagus Soup Grilled Asparagus
x2 x3 x5
Level 49 Level 51 Level 67
Spring Omelet Breakfast Waffles
x2 x2
Level 77 Level 119

Boat orders

  • Boat orders ask for 6 to 12 asparagus per crate, up to a total of 48 per boat.
  • Each unit of asparagus gives players 17 coins and 13 experience points in boat orders.

Strategy tips

  • Asparagus, like tomatoes, are hard to find in the Daily Dirt and sells well at maximum price.
    • However, be mindful that asparagus will sell slightly slower than tomatoes due to there being less recipes that use it compared to tomatoes.
  • With the exception of grilled asparagus, most recipes only require two to three asparagus, while you won't need to keep that much on hand, be very careful about selling or using all of your asparagus without planting a few since you will have a very difficult time finding it in the Daily Dirt.
